When it recovers we get several 502/504s in the next minute. This is impacting 12% of live streams and has increased our perceived latency by ~30%. It started after we rolled a small gateway config change from your side earlier today.

Attached is a small log bundle and a pcap snippet. Happy to hop on a call, but we need this stabilized — our customers are reporting UI hangs and some automated pipelines are failing.

Attachments: logs.tar.gz, pcap-snippet.txt

Thanks,

Subject: Re: Realtime feed: repeated websocket timeouts and chunk stalls

Thanks for the data — I took a quick look at the logs and our streaming dashboards. Preliminary notes:

- Symptom: sustained stalls where the server-side runtime stops emitting chunks for ~60-90s, followed by reconnects and 502/504 errors.
- Observed correlates: a spike in proxy connection backlog and ephemeral worker OOM kills on a small subset of nodes in the us-west pool around 19:28 PT.
- Root suspect: a recent edge proxy change to keepalive + header-buffer-size that interacts poorly with chunked transfer framing under high concurrency; when a worker blocks the request loop, the proxy queues connections and then times out client sockets.

Immediate mitigations I recommend (low-risk):
1) Route Multistream AI traffic to an older edge pool with the previous proxy config (quick config flip, no deploy) — reduces exposure immediately.
2) Increase server-side transfer buffer and bump HTTP keepalive timeouts to prevent premature proxy resets (config change).
3) Enable an automatic fallback to the 2.3.x model variant for streams if we detect >5s chunk gap for a session.

I can push #1 and #2 as config changes; #3 requires a small runtime toggle and a canary, I estimate ~90 minutes to test + rollout.

Jordan
Jordan Blake
Runtime Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: URGENT: Multistream AI production outage — exec attention required

David — bringing this to you because impact is material and customer is asking for credits and an SLA exception. Summary:
- Impact window: 2028-07-19 19:28 PT onward
- Customer: Multistream AI (high-growth startup; significant usage in our hosted pool)
- Symptom: websocket/chunked-transfer stalls leading to 12% of streams failing and a ~30% increase in median UI latency for affected customers.
- Root cause (tentative): interaction between recent edge proxy config changes and host-side backpressure that creates chunked-transfer stalls under concurrency.

Proposed immediate actions (need exec approval to proceed now):
1) Approve routing Multistream traffic to legacy edge pool (operational config flip) — will be done within 15 minutes of approval.
2) Approve out-of-window hotfix deploy (runtime toggle for fallback to model 2.3.x + increased transfer buffers) — requires 90–120 minutes and elevated change authority.
3) CS ask: offer 30% credit on billable usage for the impacted 48-hour window and extend priority support until the issue is fully resolved.

I've attached the diagnostic logs and a hotfix diff (hotfix-pr.diff). Also opened INF-4821 with runbook and rollback plan.

Request: please reply with APPROVE/NO and any guidance about credit. We're on standby to execute.

—Kimberly
